tooltip.fast-noteblocks.invert_scroll: Makes wheel-down raise the selected pitch instead of wheel-up.
tooltip.fast-noteblocks.view_distance: Maximum distance at which note labels are shown.
tooltip.fast-noteblocks.interaction_dela: Extra ticks between tuning interactions. 0 restores the original maximum of one interaction per client tick.
tooltip.fast-noteblocks.wait_for_ack: Waits for the changed pitch to return from the server before sending the next interaction. Safer on restrictive or laggy servers, but slower.
tooltip.fast-noteblocks.require_line_of_: Cancels tuning if another block obstructs the path from your eyes to the note block. Disabled by default.
tooltip.fast-noteblocks.sequence_enabled: Automatically tunes newly placed note blocks using the repeating sequence below. Can also be toggled with a hotkey.
tooltip.fast-noteblocks.sequence: Comma-separated note numbers from 0 to 24. Spaces are ignored; example: 0, 4, 7, 12.
error.fast-noteblocks.sequence: Use comma-separated whole numbers from 0 to 24.

tooltip.fast-noteblocks.mod_enabled: Master switch for every Fast Noteblocks feature.
tooltip.fast-noteblocks.overlays_enabled: Master switch for all in-world overlays. The overlay keybind changes this setting persistently.
tooltip.fast-noteblocks.note_block_overl: Shows note block labels and enables their overlay controls.
tooltip.fast-noteblocks.nearby_previews: Shows labels on all nearby note blocks. When disabled, a note block appears only while aiming at its center label position.
tooltip.fast-noteblocks.radial_controls: Shows the A-G radial menu and enables scroll-to-tune controls.
